Enterprise Edition.note: Keep in English. Some legacy strings translate edition names (e.g. 'Командная редакция' for Team Edition); do not follow that pattern.

Team Edition.note: Keep in English despite legacy 'Командная редакция' appearing in about-dialog strings.

Channels.note: Product name, keep in English. The common noun 'channel' is 'канал'.

SSO.note: Keep abbreviation; when spelled out, existing strings use 'единый вход' / 'единого входа'.

MFA.note: Keep abbreviation; when spelled out, use 'многофакторная аутентификация'.

System Console.note: Capitalize as 'Системная консоль' when used as the named UI area. Consistent in existing translations.

marketplace.note: Existing translations consistently use 'магазин плагинов'. If the context covers apps beyond plugins, 'маркетплейс' is an acceptable alternative, but prefer the established term.

team.note: Same word as 'command' in Russian; existing translations rely on context. Plural 'команды'.

post.note: Existing translations render both 'post' and 'message' as 'сообщение'; do not use 'пост'.

thread.note: Majority rendering; existing strings occasionally use 'тема' or 'ветка' — avoid those, and avoid the anglicism 'тред'. The Threads view is 'Обсуждения'.

direct message.note: Majority rendering (85+ occurrences); a few legacy strings use 'прямое сообщение' — avoid. Plural 'личные сообщения'.

mention.note: Verb: 'упомянуть'. '@mention' can stay '@упоминание' or keep the @ with the username untouched.

pin.note: Existing translations are inconsistent ('Прикрепить сообщение' in the post menu vs 'Закреплённые сообщения' in the channel header). Prefer 'закрепить' / 'закреплённые сообщения' (standard Telegram/Slack convention). Unpin: 'открепить'.

bookmark.note: Verb: 'добавить в закладки'. Consistent in existing translations.

saved messages.note: Save: 'сохранить'; unsave: 'убрать из сохранённых'. Existing strings write it without ё ('сохраненные').

emoji.note: Indeclinable. Existing translations are split between 'эмодзи' and legacy 'смайлик' (custom-emoji admin strings); prefer 'эмодзи', which mobile also uses.

custom emoji.note: Plural 'пользовательские эмодзи'. Legacy strings use 'пользовательский смайлик' — prefer 'эмодзи'.

status.note: For user availability. 'Состояние' appears in existing strings only for system/billing state, not user status.

custom status.note: Consistent in existing mobile and webapp strings.

do not disturb.note: Capitalized as 'Не беспокоить' when shown as a status value.

away.note: Existing status value is 'Отошёл' (masculine past form, conventional for status labels).

online.note: Status value 'В сети'; existing strings occasionally use 'онлайн' in prose.

out of office.note: Existing status value is 'Не на работе'.

session.note: Existing usage is mixed: 'сеанс' (46) vs 'сессия' (31). 'Сеанс' is the slight majority and the standard Windows/Microsoft term; either is understood, but stay consistent.

sign out.note: Existing 'Log Out' is 'Выйти'. Translate 'log out' identically.

mute.note: For channels (existing 'Mute Channel' = 'Отключить уведомления'). Distinct from Calls 'mute' = 'отключить звук/микрофон'. A single-word alternative 'заглушить' appears once in existing strings.

favorite.note: Sidebar category 'Избранное'; verb: 'добавить в избранное'; unfavorite: 'убрать из избранного'.

slash command.note: Established majority rendering in existing translations (25 occurrences vs 2 'слэш-команда'). Keep even though 'слэш-команда' is more literal.

webhook.note: Majority rendering; a few legacy strings keep English 'Webhook' — prefer the transliteration consistently.

trigger word.note: Existing usage is inconsistent ('ключевое слово', 'слово-триггер', 'триггерное слово'). Prefer 'триггерное слово' to avoid colliding with 'keyword' = 'ключевое слово' in notification settings.

trial.note: Existing strings mix 'пробный период' (the period) and 'пробная версия' (the trial product/license); use 'пробный период' for the time-limited period sense.

unread.note: Adjective agrees with noun: 'непрочитанные сообщения/каналы'. The Unreads view: 'Непрочитанные'.

public channel.note: Existing usage is split between 'публичный канал' and 'общий канал'; prefer 'публичный канал' because 'общий канал' collides with both 'shared channel' and the Town Square default channel name.

shared channel.note: Existing rendering. Beware: 'Общий канал' is also the existing translation of the Town Square default channel name — rely on context, or use 'подключённый общий канал' in ambiguous admin prose.

channel purpose.note: Several existing system messages mistranslate 'purpose' as 'заголовок канала' (collides with header); use 'назначение канала'.

urgent.note: Priority label 'Срочно'; adjective form 'срочный/срочное' when modifying a noun (e.g. 'срочное упоминание').

recap.note: No existing translation yet (new AI feature). 'Сводка' matches Russian conventions for AI activity summaries; plural 'сводки'.

burn-on-read.note: No established translation yet; feature-discovery strings paraphrase ('сообщения, которые автоматически удаляются после прочтения'). For the label/adjective use 'сгорающее после прочтения (сообщение)'; the all-caps badge can be 'СГОРАЕТ ПОСЛЕ ПРОЧТЕНИЯ'.

personal access token.note: Existing strings mix 'персональный' and 'личный токен доступа'; prefer 'персональный токен доступа' (matches GitHub/GitLab ru convention).

announcement banner.note: Existing strings use 'баннер объявления' / 'баннер с объявлением'; one admin-permissions string mistranslates it as 'Система уведомлений' — ignore that.

channel banner.note: No existing translation; follows 'баннер' + genitive pattern used for announcement banner.

keyword.note: Plural 'ключевые слова'. Reserved for notification keywords; use 'триггерное слово' for webhook trigger words.

collapsed reply threads.note: No stable existing translation; derived from thread = 'обсуждение' and existing 'Collapsed' = 'Свёрнуто'.

auto-translation.note: Consistent in existing server strings; 'auto-translated' = 'переведено автоматически' or badge 'АВТОПЕРЕВОД'.

data retention.note: Policy: 'политика хранения данных'. Existing strings also use 'удержание' in one place — avoid.

compliance export.note: Majority rendering in the System Console; some strings use 'экспорт соответствия' / 'отчёты о соответствии'. Stay with 'экспорт комплаенса' for the feature name.

access control.note: Attribute-based access control: 'контроль доступа на основе атрибутов (ABAC)'.

Town Square.note: Existing server translation of the default channel name. Collides with 'shared channel' = 'общий канал'; keep capitalized as a proper channel name.

Off-Topic.note: Existing server translation of the default channel name; keep for consistency (alternative 'Оффтопик' is not used in the repos).
